facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: He woke up. The shoes were done. He was surprised. Elves came at night.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The next morning, the shoemaker found a beautiful surprise. The shoes were already finished perfectly on the table. He could not believe his eyes because the work was amazing. Elves came at night and made the shoes while he slept. A customer came and bought the shoes right away. The shoemaker was so happy and bought more leather.
facts.Word cards: elves = 요정들 / surprised = 놀란 / shoes = 신발 / watched = 지켜봤다
